data.name: Shambhunath
data.long_meaning: Shambhu means auspicious and nath means lord. Shambhunath is the lord of peace, prosperity, and happiness. He is the god who bestows all the desires and fulfills all the wishes of his devotees.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shambhunath represents the divine grace and blessings of Lord Shiva. He is the embodiment of compassion and forgiveness. He is the god who removes all the obstacles and paves the way for success and happiness.
data.numerology_meaning: The number six signifies love, harmony, and balance. People with life path number six are nurturing, caring, and self-sacrificing. They have a deep sense of responsibility and a strong desire to help others.

in_sanskrit.name: शम्भनाथ
in_sanskrit.meaning: शानत्यश्च भूतभवनभरण नाथ (Shana means calm, peaceful, and bhutbhava means all living beings. Nath means lord, protector)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is calm, peaceful and protects all living beings

in_tamil.name: ஶம்புநாத
in_tamil.meaning: ஶான்தம் நாத்தின் அல்லது ஶாங்கர் நாத்தின் அல்லது ஶங்கத்திர் நாத்தின் அல்லது ஶங்கார் நாத்தின் அல்லது ஶாம்பானாத்தின் அல்லது ஶாம்பத் (Shambu means calm and peaceful, Nath means lord, protector)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is calm and peaceful, and protects all

in_marathi.name: Shambhunath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Peace and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shambhunath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shambhu means auspicious and nath means lord. Shambhunath is the lord of peace, prosperity, and happiness. He is the god who bestows all the desires and fulfills all the wishes of his devotees.

in_bengali.name: Shambhunath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Peace and Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shambhunath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Shambhu means auspicious and nath means lord. Shambhunath is the lord of peace, prosperity, and happiness. He is the god who bestows all the desires and fulfills all the wishes of his devotees.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shambhunath holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism, particularly in the northern regions of India. It is widely associated with Lord Shiva, who is also known as Shambhu or Mahadev. In some traditional Hindu almanacs and calendars, certain days or months are dedicated to Shambhunath or are also referred to as the 'auspicious days of Shambhunath'. These days are believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Shambhunath is considered the embodiment of peace, love, compassion, and happiness. He is revered as the 'Lord of the Universe' who bestows his blessings upon his devotees. In times of hardship and suffering, it is believed that invoking Shambhunath's name can bring inner peace, tranquility, and strength. This ancient Hindu name continues to inspire hope, faith, and courage among millions of devotees worldwide.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Priya Shambhunath in Chennai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Shambhunath, which means "God of Peace and Prosperity". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Shambhunath: Radiant Lord of Peace and Compassion. The name embodies the inner peace and compassionate nature of the divine, bestowing blessings of happiness and prosperity upon its bearer.

seo.description_paragraph: Shambhunath is a name deeply rooted in Hinduism. It is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘shambhu’ (auspicious) and ‘nath’ (lord). The name is believed to represent the embodiment of peace, prosperity, and benevolence. Shambhunath is considered a revered name in Hindu culture and is often associated with the Lord Shiva and Lord Krishna. Despite its rich history, Shambhunath is not a commonly used name today. Nonetheless, it continues to hold significance among those who value the spiritual and cultural traditions of Hinduism.
